open_decisions.native_vs_lowdetail: unresolved by design; the primary CI includes zero
open_decisions.promote_dev_best_to_deploy: blocked: needs a seed replication, a fresh 4090 measurement, submission rebuild and raw-B1 parity on the MR graph

purpose: freeze the MR round's candidates so later work cannot silently replace them; registration records what was run, not a claim that it generalises

DEPLOY_FALLBACK.why: unchanged: still the only model with a complete deployment set (submission build, raw-B1 parity, negative controls, 4090 timing)

DEV_BEST.caveat: a point-estimate choice only: MR-NATIVE minus MR-LOWDETAIL is -0.001871 with a paired CI of [-0.006395, +0.000975], which includes zero, so superiority over MR-LOWDETAIL is NOT established
DEV_BEST.why: lowest observed V0 among development candidates

LEN_CONTROL.why: the control both MR arms were measured against; preserved unchanged

MR_REFERENCE.caveat: not automatically the cheaper deployment model: both MR arms run the same 768x432 canvas and the same radius-4 graph, and the lowdetail arm additionally pays a 768->384->768 resize
MR_REFERENCE.why: preserved so the detail contrast stays reproducible

deployment_checks.submission_path: smoke-built on 12 official test clips with --mr-detail native

timing_contract.reading: the MR graph is about 1.48x slower than E1-EXP and uses about 1.43x the FLOPs, but both stay far inside their limits: at ~24.5 ms the time multiplier is exactly 1.0, and the FLOPs headroom falls from 9.02x to 6.30x without approaching the cutoff
timing_contract.reason: the MR arms changed the motion branch graph: a 768x432 canvas with its own backbone pass and radius 4 at both levels, so the E1-EXP figure does not transfer to any MR checkpoint
timing_contract.score_time_term: x(1 + (T_ms - 100)/200), so T <= 100 ms carries no penalty
